summary: Moved the Android didFirstFrameRendered notification from VideoSink.onFrame to WebRTC EglRenderer's RenderListener, which fires after swapBuffers. Pixel runtime produced the post-swap callback and a fresh Calculator thumbnail, but the large local preview remained black. The APK was installed and the short app-only capture was stopped; MediaProjection and voice session were then verified closed.

checks.name: Native renderer callback and LiveKit widget callback tests
Pixel 7 app-only screen-share retest
checks.device: Google Pixel 7, Calculator task, microphone muted
checks.observation: Installed 1.0.18+2027 on Pixel 7. Selected Calculator app task (dumpsys media_projection showed RECORD_CONTENT_TASK and com.google.android.calculator); voice participant card displayed a fresh Calculator thumbnail and logs contained [screen-preview] local_renderer=first_swap_buffers, but the large local viewer stayed black in screenshot /private/tmp/boohtacord-pixel-preview-2027.png. Microphone remained off. Stopped the screen share (dumpsys media_projection returned null) and exited SHARE_TEST. No Mac/paired receiver was used.

limitations: The post-swap callback proves an EGL surface buffer was swapped, not that Flutter's texture compositor displayed the expected pixels; the runtime result confirms that distinction matters.
Remote receiver playback and sender encoded-frame counters remain unverified; FE-59 stays open.
remaining: Investigate Android local preview texture/compositor path despite successful app capture, thumbnail update, and EGL swap event. Then verify sender/receiver stats and paired remote playback when an authorized second viewer is available.
